long_biography.plain_text:
Walker Marine Group's recognition as Pursuit's leading dealer in 2018 placed Christine M. Walker alongside her husband, Jim, as owners of a major southwest Florida marine retailer. Its business combined new and pre-owned boat sales with service, parts, financing, insurance and storage across several Gulf Coast locations.

Walker's role was sustained rather than ceremonial. She served as the company's vice president and was part of its five-person team by 1991. The group also earned Pursuit's Gold Flagship dealer status for business standards, service, staffing and facilities. She and Jim became presenting sponsors of Marco Island's American Cancer Society Imagination Ball.
